scripts.dev: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true concurrently "npm run dev -w @sermonsmith/web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build -w @sermonsmith/web && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build -w @sermonsmith/web && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build -w @sermonsmith/web && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build -w @sermonsmith/web && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:all: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm run build -w @sermonsmith/web && electron-builder --win --mac --linux
